mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT TRUNC(ONSEN_USE_DATE) AS "date", ONSEN_IDX AS onsenIdx, ONSEN_TIME_SLOT AS timeSlot FROM ONSEN_RESERVATION WHERE ONSEN_USE_DATE >= #{rangeStart} AND ONSEN_USE_DATE < #{rangeEnd} AND ONSEN_TIME_SLOT IS NOT NULL AND NVL(ONSEN_STATUS, ' ') != '예약취소'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ONSEN ( ONSEN_NAME, ONSEN_IMAGE, ONSEN_INFO, ADMIN_IDX, ONSEN_SALE_YN, ONSEN_MEMO, ONSEN_HOUR, ONSEN_PRICE ) VALUES ( #{onsenName}, #{onsenImage}, #{onsenInfo}, #{adminIdx}, #{onsenSaleYn}, #{onsenMemo}, #{onsenHour}, #{onsenPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ONSEN WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} ORDER BY ONSEN_IDX DESC
SELECT * FROM ONSEN WHERE ONSEN_SALE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY ONSEN_IDX
